description:
Check the date and age of the latest GE catalogue configuration update. This does not report how fresh item prices are.
Call with {} for catalogue diagnostics; use get_item_details for item prices/metadata or get_all_categories for category IDs.
Makes one Jagex read. No auth or cache; API failures are errors. Shared HTTP limit: 60 requests/IP/minute; honor Retry-After on 429.
name: get_ge_info

configurationAgeDays.description: UTC calendar days since configuration update; negative for a future upstream date

fetchedAt.description: Server retrieval time, not a price update timestamp

lastConfigUpdateDate.description: Configuration UTC date derived from RuneDay

lastConfigUpdateRuneday.description: Upstream RuneDay counter for catalogue configuration update

priceFreshness.description: Configuration metadata does not report item-price freshness

title: GE Catalogue Refresh Status
